preConditions.onFailMessage: Link at least one existing workspace owner to an active account before upgrading. Match provider ID and immutable subject, never username or email. See the account membership upgrade guide.
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(DISTINCT original.workspace_id) FROM workspace_membership original WHERE original.role = 'OWNER' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM workspace_membership candidate JOIN "user" actor ON actor.id = candidate.user_id AND actor.type = 'USER' JOIN identity_provider provider ON provider.id = actor.provider_id AND provider.type IN ('GITHUB', 'GITLAB') JOIN identity_link link ON link.provider_id = actor.provider_id AND link.subject = actor.native_id::text AND link.team_id IS NULL AND link.disabled_at IS NULL JOIN account person ON person.id = link.account_id AND person.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE candidate.workspace_id = original.workspace_id AND candidate.role = 'OWNER' )

changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO workspace_account_membership (account_id, workspace_id, role, source, suspended, created_at) SELECT link.account_id, membership.workspace_id, CASE min(CASE membership.role WHEN 'OWNER' THEN 0 WHEN 'ADMIN' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END) WHEN 0 THEN 'OWNER' WHEN 1 THEN 'ADMIN' ELSE 'MEMBER' END, 'MIGRATED', false, min(membership.created_at) FROM workspace_membership membership JOIN "user" actor ON actor.id = membership.user_id AND actor.type = 'USER' JOIN identity_provider provider ON provider.id = actor.provider_id AND provider.type IN ('GITHUB', 'GITLAB') JOIN identity_link link ON link.provider_id = actor.provider_id AND link.subject = actor.native_id::text AND link.team_id IS NULL AND link.disabled_at IS NULL JOIN account person ON person.id = link.account_id AND person.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY link.account_id, membership.workspace_id;
